sections.kicker: Prepared for Casa Cicheti by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Casa Cicheti has a room people remember. The headline does not say so.
sections.keep: The dining room photo. Copper pans overhead and striped banquettes make a room only this house has.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Eat well, laugh often, love much.
pins.what: The headline is a sentiment that fits any Italian restaurant.
pins.why: It says how Casa Cicheti wants you to feel, not why you would choose it over the trattoria next door.
pins.how: Replace the greeting with the one thing only this house does, and let the Italian line support it.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Diners choose on price and distance, because the first line gives them nothing else.

pins.area: Warm dining room photo with copper pans hanging overhead
pins.what: The photo is the strongest thing on the page and it carries no words.
pins.why: The copper pans and striped banquettes are specific to this house. The headline over them could belong to anyone.
pins.how: Write the line from what is in this photo.
pins.label: Your photo
pins.cost: The room does the selling that the words skip.

pins.quote: Mangia bene, ridi spesso, ama molto
pins.what: The Italian line is the original, and the English headline is its translation.
pins.why: The most Italian thing on the page sits smaller, under a headline that says it in a way any restaurant could.
pins.how: Lead with the Italian and let the English follow.
pins.label: Your tagline
pins.cost: The one line that sounds like the house reads as a footnote.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Casa Cicheti. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and they point the same way.
